technical.q: How does FlashAttention-2 optimize memory bandwidth during LLM self-attention?
technical.a: FlashAttention-2 computes attention on GPU SRAM tiles without materializing the full N x N attention matrix in High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM), achieving 2-4x speedups by reducing HBM read/writes.

technical.q: What is the difference between FP16 and FP8 quantization in TensorRT-LLM?
technical.a: FP8 quantization uses 8-bit floating point representations (E4M3/E5M2 formats), reducing GPU memory consumption by 50% compared to FP16 while maintaining model accuracy via scaling factors.
